title: Pending sharing operations can continue after teardown
test: tests/browser/host-start-teardown.spec.mjs: 'leaving the host page while the capture picker is open stops the late capture and creates no room'; tests/startOperationGuard.test.js (12 tests: 'a stopped start whose create-room ack arrives with no successor removes its room and releases its capture', 'stop, a new start, then the old late ack: no host-stopped, and the new room request waits for the old one', 'a newer start that supersedes a pending one without a teardown gets the same ordering and no host-stopped', 'a reload-preserving pagehide never lets the stale start send host-stopped', 'a reload-preserving teardown of a later start also blocks an earlier stale start's host-stopped', 'every stale exit releases exactly the resources that start acquired', 'a start torn down during OBS configuration stops OBS only when no successor owns it', 'a start torn down before its room request never holds up the next start', 'a current start settles its room step at the ack, so a later start does not wait for its transports', 'the settle wait is bounded; a stale ack after the bound is escalated and sends nothing', 'guard: ids, invalidation and the compensation fence', 'startOperationGuardFor keeps one guard per socket across view remounts')
proof: Holds. handleStartSharing checked nothing after its awaits. The browser test stubs getDisplayMedia with a picker the test answers by hand, clicks Start Sharing, leaves #host while the picker is open (isSharing is false, so no leave prompt; the view unmounts and its teardown runs), then answers the picker. On the unchanged client (built to a scratch dir and served by the lane's server.js on a private port) it failed three ways: 'rooms created after teardown' Expected 0 Received 1, 'active rooms' Expected 0 Received 1, and 'late capture track states' Expected ['ended'] Received ['live']: the torn-down start installed the capture, created a room and published into it, and the room stayed active. Fix: src/lib/startOperationGuard.mjs holds one guard per socket (it survives a host-view remount). Each start begins an operation; cleanup, terminateHostSession, handleStopSharing, the unmount teardown and pagehide invalidate it (pagehide with reload recovery as 'reload-preserve'). After every await (capture, the room step, get-rtp-capabilities, getDevice, device.load, create-send-transport, each produce, setMaxSpatialLayer, configureObsStream) and in the catch, a stale start stops its own capture tracks, closes its own transport and producers, sets no state, opens no OBS control channel, and sends host-stopped for a room it created (or the stopObsStream fallback after configure) only when no other start owns the session (activeOperation empty) and neither its teardown nor the latest one was reload-preserve. The transport's connect/produce handlers refuse for a stale start, and the capture-track 'ended' handler ignores a stale start's track. Room requests (leave-room and create-room) wait until every earlier start's request has settled and its host-stopped is on the socket, bounded by 65 s (socketRequest's own worst case for those two requests); a stale start settles only after its compensation emit. One establishObsControlChannel(op) opens the channel only for the current start and drops a channel whose ready reports failure. The unit tests drive the same createStartAttempt/requestRoom code HostView uses, with a fake host socket and server (one room per host socket) and hand-settled promises: stop then late ack with no successor emits host-stopped and settles after it; stop, new Start, late ack emits no host-stopped, the successor's leave-room/create-room come after the old ack and its room stays active; reload-preserve emits none; every stale case releases exactly its own tracks, transport and producers. Mutating the guard (dropping the activeOperation check, dropping the settle wait, or compensating unconditionally) fails 4 to 6 of them. After the fix the browser test passes and so do all 12 media-flow scenarios (run as a port-shifted copy on the private server, copy deleted); npm run lint, npm run typecheck and npm test (512/512) pass.
